sloka: लङ्काद्वीपस्य गोप्तारं कर्तारं भीमकर्मणाम् ।अस्माकं कामभोगानां दातारं रथिनां वरम् ।। ६.११४.५५ ।।
transliteration: laṅkādvīpasya goptāraṁ kartāraṁ bhīmakarmaṇām ।asmākaṁ kāmabhogānāṁ dātāraṁ rathināṁ varam ।। 6.114.55 ।।

translations.english: "Brought by force virgin girls of Devas, suras and human beings from here and there forcibly and caused the enemy women to mourn"
